persistent_identity.rule: gameplay items may expose a cosmetic/avatar representation without making CUBE authoritative over gameplay

world_surfaces.rule: billboards are world content; destination navigation is client-controlled and never grants economic truth

economic_sidecar.rule: CUBE may observe and classify signals; it does not own movement, combat, inventory, rendering, or settlement

compatibility.godot: implement protocol adapter; do not fork authoritative game rules
compatibility.unity: implement protocol adapter; do not fork authoritative game rules
compatibility.roblox: separate platform adapter/experience; consume compatible server contract where platform permits
